newsitem.title: USA: Global Intellicom sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Global Intellicom sees Q1 loss.

text.p: Global Intellicom Inc said Friday that it expects to incur a loss in the first quarter of 1997.
Global said that it expects its first quarter to be its lowest revenue quarter for the year. A company spokeswoman did not give a projection for first quarter revenues.
In a press release, the company said it projects revenues for 1997 to exceed $100 million, compared with $47 million in 1996.
It said it anticipates an improved second quarter, with revenue and earnings growing "significantly" in the third and fourth quarters.
For the first quarter last year, Global earned $0.01 a share on revenues of $8.7 million.
